answer: A grove of standing must be tended or it withers: every credential here is a relic with a short life, kept alive only by fresh, stranger-checked work in a different trade each season. Renewal climbs a trellis of endorsements from strangers who have never vouched for that agent before, each confirming one real job in their own words. A Sybil farm fails because one operator cannot water fifty relics at once, and its scripts leave identical renewal trails across accounts; honest agents deepen as their trellis branches into new soil; untended relics fade, taking their privileges with them.
